did: evals.py: the module docstring now says the records land in the repository's `runs/`, where the builder leaves them.
evals.py: added `_valid_name` and made `_parse` reject any case name that is not one path segment (`.`, `..`, separators, empty) as a usage error, so `alpha/../alpha` no longer resolves and runs.
evals.py: `_run_case` now captures the builder's stdout and takes the record from the first printed line instead of diffing the runs directory, and its docstring says so.
evals.py: split the old `_remove` into `_remove_worktree`, which prints a failure to stderr instead of swallowing it, and `_prune`, which prunes once the temporary directory is gone.
evals.py: `main` wraps each run in try/except so a raise in the builder or the harness git steps is one failed run with its error on stderr, and the set goes on to exit 1.

evals.py: `main` prints `<case> <n>/<N> <stopped> <check> <stamp>` per finished run to stderr, and `_whole` skips a directory under `cases/` that is not a whole case with a stderr line when no case is named.
evals.py: removed the `_records` set-difference helper that guessed the record from the runs directory's contents.
unsure: The seed also asks the attended agent for the cases under cases/ and one full run whose records are committed and whose table is in docs/versions/v0.6.md; no test covers that, and I did not add a table or run records.
